response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and diverse experience across architectures and languages, but lacks explicit evidence of executive leadership, UML expertise, German proficiency (only 'Basic' stated), and formal project management experience — critical for this Head of Development role.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across multiple languages and environments (DLang, Node.js, Linux)
Strong track record of mentoring and teaching (workshops, courses, CI/CD setup)
concerns: German language proficiency listed as 'Basic' — fails C1 requirement
No clear evidence of architectural leadership or UML modeling in resume
Lacks explicit experience in client advisory, requirements management, or IT compliance
